positioning.brief_for_strategy:
5 competitor(s) read - open ground on control; 5 of them show a named customer and we show none.

**Open ground - lead here.** Nothing else in this list differentiates this company, and a claim nobody else makes is worth more than a stronger claim everybody makes:
- **control** - Email outputs include subject, preview, body and a call to action, with text copying/export and HTML preview. (nobody else claims it).

**Table stakes - true, and worth nothing as an argument.** Every competitor says these. An email that leads on one of them is an email the reader has already received:
- **speed** - A generation can take several minutes. (2 competitor(s) also claim it).
- **quality** - E-commerce products, SaaS and other offers are supported as inputs, though quality for every sector has not been established. (4 competitor(s) also claim it).
- **support** - MarketingOS does not send emails, publish campaigns, or guarantee opens, clicks, revenue or conversions. (4 competitor(s) also claim it).
- **other** - LinkedIn outputs are drafts for review and copying; the application does not send messages.; MarketingOS is an email campaign drafting and market-research application.; Users can register a brand, add website material or pasted text, request competitor analysis and audience research, and generate reviewed draft emails.; The application drafts content; users review and transfer it into their own sending tool.; Existing invited users can sign in at https://app.orqagent.com/login/.; The current pilot asks existing invited users to test one real offer and report phrases they would keep or rewrite, plus factual errors and time spent editing.; Users point MarketingOS at their website or upload a PDF or screenshot and ask for what they need in their own words.; A brand's LinkedIn workspace proposes who is worth writing to, derived from the compiled knowledge and audience map, and searches the public web for profiles matching those criteria.; Writing to a LinkedIn profile uses the same knowledge and audience as other campaigns, with one Strategist call producing a single message instead of a sequence.; MarketingOS reads a company's material into a set of allowed facts, decides campaign structure, writes each email, has drafts reviewed by someone with no product knowledge, rewrites what did not land, and delivers finished reviewed email text ready to copy and paste after checking facts, links and brand voice.; Incomplete runs retain their delivery count and the reason they need attention.; MarketingOS finds named contacts by reading each organisation's own pages for a published way in, keeping only contact details actually found on a fetched page rather than guessed email addresses.; Private pilot accounts are provisioned by the founder, and public registration is closed.; MarketingOS reads the competitive market, identifying who buyers are really deciding between, what competitors promise, which claims are unique, and whether anyone on the open web has vouched for the company.; MarketingOS reads market demand to identify who would actually buy the product, separate from who the company says it sells to.; MarketingOS's audience research surfaces buyer types such as an adjacent industry with the same problem, the daily pain-feeler who doesn't sign, the agency that could place it in front of forty clients, and the company that becomes a buyer only after a triggering event.; Each identified buyer persona comes back with an estimated hit rate and supporting reasoning, and can be used as the target every campaign draft is written to and graded against.; Email campaigns run through the full strategy-and-review pipeline.; MarketingOS positions itself as enabling email campaigns without hiring a copywriter. (4 competitor(s) also claim it).

**Where the field is ahead of us.** Do not raise these:
- **price** - Copy.ai, Hoppy Copy, HubSpot Marketing Hub, Mailchimp claim this and we do not. Do not invite the comparison: an email that raises this axis loses on it.
- **breadth** - Jasper, Copy.ai, Hoppy Copy, HubSpot Marketing Hub, Mailchimp claim this and we do not. Do not invite the comparison: an email that raises this axis loses on it.
- **effort** - Jasper, Copy.ai, Hoppy Copy, HubSpot Marketing Hub claim this and we do not. Do not invite the comparison: an email that raises this axis loses on it.
- **security** - Jasper, Copy.ai, Mailchimp claim this and we do not. Do not invite the comparison: an email that raises this axis loses on it.
- **proof** - Hoppy Copy, Mailchimp claim this and we do not. Do not invite the comparison: an email that raises this axis loses on it.

**Proof asymmetry.** 5 of the 5 competitors read display a named customer or a quotation on their own site, and this company displays none. A reader comparing them is not comparing two sets of claims - they are comparing a claim to a claim with somebody's name under it. Plan an email that does not need to be believed on trust: something they can check, or test, in a minute.

**The category's own words.** Two or more competitors spend these. A sentence built only out of them says nothing about this company:
- agents, brand, content, data, marketing, voice, automatically, automations, brings, create, draft, email, emails, engine, generate, growth, integrates, plan, security, templates, time, together, tone, 000
